Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was changing lanes on the highway in League City, Texas, when a vehicle in the lane beside me moved over and
clipped the side of my car. I pulled onto the shoulder right away and stayed there until the other driver and I had
exchanged details. My car's left side was scraped and the mirror was knocked loose. Since that day I have described
the events the same way each time I have spoken with the adjuster, the repair shop, and my doctor. I am the named
driver on this policy and was driving my own vehicle at the time. The impact jolted me hard against the seatbelt, and I
have had persistent pain in my right shoulder ever since, which has made lifting and reaching difficult for work and at
home. I am asking the insurer to cover the repairs to my vehicle and my medical treatment for the shoulder injury.
